mismatch.source: Clark, Vashishtha, Harris, Dietrich, Wang, 'Design Flows and Collateral for the ASAP7 7nm FinFET Predictive Process Design Kit', IEEE MSE 2017 (A_VT 1.2 mV.um, from Giles et al., 'High sigma measurement of random threshold voltage variation in 14nm Logic FinFET technology', VLSI Tech. 2015: 1.07 n / 1.23 p); the ASAP7 PDK itself has no statistical models (TT/SS/FF cards only)
